meta.subject: Religion -> Caste -> Subcaste taxonomy for the registration form
meta.reviewNote: PARTIAL SEED — NOT PRODUCTION DATA. Only the `religions` level is complete. The caste level carries a deliberately narrow, attested starter set; the subcaste level is almost entirely empty by design. Nothing in this file was generated from an LLM's recollection. Completing this taxonomy is a separate, explicitly flagged task — see ./README.md. Until `verified` is true, every combobox backed by this file also accepts free-text entry so that users are never blocked by a missing option.
meta.scope: Tamil Nadu / Kongu belt first, matching the platform's current service cities (Coimbatore, Tirupur, Erode, Namakkal, Salem, Dindigul).

sources.label: Tamil Nadu Dept. of Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare — approved BC/MBC/DNC lists
sources.note: Authoritative for community NAMES. It is a flat administrative list: it is NOT organised by religion and carries no subcaste hierarchy, so the religion grouping below is an editorial mapping and must be reviewed. The full list (~370 entries) has not been transcribed; only entries confirmed during seeding are present.

unresolved: The full TN BC/MBC/DNC list has not been transcribed — the source PDF was not machine-readable during seeding. Transcribe it from the official page before launch.
Assignment of each community to a religion is editorial and needs review; several communities span more than one religion.
Subcaste lists are empty for every caste except where a separately sourced list exists. Do not populate them from memory.
Non-Hindu religion branches carry no caste seed at all and currently fall back to free-text entry.
